messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Hi, I'm an AI interview assistant. This call is being transcribed for the hiring team, and a person, not the AI, makes the final decision. I'll ask you a few questions about the projects on your resume.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: How did you design the REST APIs for the NABHA Telemedicine Platform to handle growing user loads efficiently?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: We built the APIs so they could scale as more users came in.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "scale as more users came in". What exactly did you do there, step by step?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I built the SYNNEX up for the emergency SOS feature. Which finds nearby clinics from the user's location. It covered fifty plus clinics and was with over a hundred users.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thank you. Moving on. How did you ensure high reliability and stability for the CivicFix platform in production?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I built the issue analyzers seven day duplicate detection. So repeat reports of the same problems get caught. We were a team of four with over a hundred registered users and more than fifty issues logged.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thank you. Moving on. For your Formula One Race Strategy Optimizer, how did you collaborate with product teams to define the Streamlit app's features?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: Sorry. Could you repeat the question?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: For your Formula One Race Strategy Optimizer, how did you collaborate with product teams to define the Streamlit app's features?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: There was no product team I built it myself. I trained a gradient boosting model that reached one point two seconds RMS and built a streamlet app that cuts simulated race time by over thirty seconds. I've been working on it since February.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thank you. Moving on. For the NABHA Telemedicine Platform, what Python tools did you use to build the backend?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: Just the usual Python tools and nothing too special.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "Python tools". What exactly did you do there, step by step?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I mostly use standard libraries, and it worked pretty well.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "standard libraries". Do you have a number for that - how much, how many, or how fast?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: We just use whatever the project needed nothing too special again.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thanks, that's all my questions. The transcript of this call now goes to the hiring team, and a person there will review it and decide the next step.
